display.purpose: The single H1 on the homepage hero only.

label.purpose: Nav items, buttons, HUD readouts, terminal chrome.

micro.purpose: Rarity badges, tech-stack tags, index numbers, smallest HUD readouts.

nano.purpose: Terminal title bar, modal stat labels, chrome-within-chrome metadata below Micro.

code.purpose: Inline <code> within MDX prose, a notch under Body.

shadows.name: pixel
shadows.purpose: Default resting elevation for cards, buttons, bordered panels.

motion.name: crt-on
motion.purpose: Terminal power-on: vertical scale collapse from 0.02 to 1.04 to 1.

motion.name: crt-off
motion.purpose: Terminal power-off: the power-on sequence in reverse.

motion.name: blink-steps
motion.purpose: Hard on/off blink, no easing, like an arcade cabinet light.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square-cornered CTA with a hard offset shadow; text and border/shadow recolor to the theme accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; background: #16162a; color: #e8e8f4; border: 2px solid #34346a; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 #34346a; padding: 12px 24px; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { color: #ff2d78; border-color: #ff2d78; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 #ff2d78; }

components.name: Project Card
components.description: Rarity-tinted project card: square corners, hard pixel shadow, lifts up-left on hover.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-card-project { background: #16162a; border: 2px solid #34346a; border-radius: 0; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 #34346a; padding: 16px; transition: transform 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-card-project:hover, .ds-card-project:focus-within { border-color: #ff2d78; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 #ff2d78; transform: translate(-2px, -2px); } .ds-card-project__rarity { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ff2d78; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-project__title { font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #e8e8f4; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-project__summary { font-family: 'VT323', monospace; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #8f8fb3; margin: 0; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Numbered nav link with an arrow indicator that's always visible and pulsing when active, otherwise revealed on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #e8e8f4; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-item:hover, .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { color: #ff2d78; } .ds-nav-item--active { color: #ffd400; } .ds-nav-item__arrow { color: #ff2d78; } .ds-nav-item--active .ds-nav-item__arrow { animation: ds-pulse 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; } .ds-nav-item__index { font-size: 0.625rem; color: #8f8fb3; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

components.name: HUD Micro-Button
components.description: Theme swatch / mute / terminal toggle button used inside the persistent HUD strip — bordered-only at rest, filled solid with the accent when active/pressed.
components.css: .ds-hud-btn { border: 1px solid #34346a; background: transparent; color: #8f8fb3; font-family: 'Press Start 2P', monospace; font-size: 0.625rem; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 6px; transition: border-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-hud-btn:hover, .ds-hud-btn:focus-visible { border-color: #ff2d78; color: #e8e8f4; } .ds-hud-btn--active { border-color: #ff2d78; background: #ff2d78; color: #0a0a12; }

narrative.overview: Every screen is a level in the same cabinet, not a page on a resume site. The system borrows its entire visual grammar from late-80s/early-90s arcade hardware and boxart — hard square corners, offset drop-shadow silhouettes standing in for sprite shading, chunky monospace pixel type, and CRT scanlines laid over the whole viewport. Four selectable palettes (arcade, phosphor, synthwave, gameboy) work like cartridge skins: the layout and components never change shape, only which cartridge is inserted changes the color story. This is explicitly not a SaaS landing page or a generic dev-portfolio template — there is no gradient text, no soft rounded card grid, no tracked-uppercase eyebrows. The wrapper is playful and loud in its references, but every mechanic (XP, achievements, rarity tiers, the hidden terminal) still points back at real projects and a real resume; the game never outruns the substance it's dressed around.
keyCharacteristics: Zero border-radius anywhere — every corner is a hard right angle.
Elevation is a solid offset duplicate (a pixel shadow), never a blurred drop shadow.
Two-font system: Press Start 2P for anything structural, VT323 for anything read at length.
Interactive states recolor to the theme's accent rather than changing shape or adding motion weight.
The same eight semantic color roles are re-skinned per theme; components must never reference a raw hex value.

rules.name: The One Cartridge Rule
rules.body: A component only ever reads the eight semantic tokens via the Tailwind color classes that map to them. A raw hex value hard-coded into a component breaks the instant a visitor switches cartridges.

rules.name: The Rarity Rule
rules.body: Rarity tiers always map to the same four tokens in the same order regardless of theme: common → muted, rare → accent-alt, epic → accent, legendary → highlight.

rules.name: The Cartridge Label Rule
rules.body: Press Start 2P never appears below 0.5rem (Nano) or runs longer than a short label/phrase. A sentence that needs to be read comfortably belongs in VT323.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: border-radius is 0px, everywhere, with no exceptions. A rounded corner is the fastest way to break the cartridge illusion.

dos: Do keep every color reference to the eight semantic tokens so a component survives a theme switch untouched.
Do use the pixel shadow (4px 4px 0 0, no blur) for any element that needs to read as raised.
Do keep Press Start 2P short: labels, headings, badges, never body paragraphs.
Do map rarity tiers to the same four tokens in the same order every time.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on every hover/entrance animation.
donts: Don't add border-radius anywhere. Zero exceptions.
Don't reach for a blurred box-shadow, backdrop-filter glass panel, or glow effect.
Don't build a generic corporate portfolio layout: hero + skill-icon row + uniform card grid + contact form.
Don't use gradient text, tracked-uppercase eyebrow labels, or a feature-card grid.
Don't let a retro effect win over readability or accessibility.
Don't hard-code a hex value into a component.
